name: 2,4-dimethoxy-α-methyl-5-(methylthio)benzeneethanamine
summary: Meta-DOT, also known as 5-methylthio-2,4-dimethoxyamphetamine or as 5-thio-TMA-2, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to TMA-2. It is the analogue of TMA-2 in which the methoxy group at the 5 position has been replaced with a methylthio group. In addition, the drug is a positional isomer of Aleph (DOT; para-DOT).

pharmacology.text: The effects of meta-DOT have been reported to include threshold effects, a vague awareness of something or of a "thinness", and possibly some brief cardiovascular stimulation.

uses.en: It has no medical use and is known mainly from Shulgin's book PiHKAL.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，主要是因 Shulgin 的書《PiHKAL》而為人所知。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，主要是因 Shulgin 的书《PiHKAL》而为人所知。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. The few reports describe only faint effects and possibly brief stimulation of the heart.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。僅有的少數報告只描述了輕微的效果，可能還有短暫的心臟刺激。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。仅有的少数报告只描述了轻微的效果，可能还有短暂的心脏刺激。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin made versions of TMA-2 with a sulfur atom in different positions. Moving the sulfur changed activity sharply: para-DOT (Aleph) is strongly active, while meta-DOT barely produced effects.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin 合成了硫原子位於不同位置的 TMA-2 衍生物。移動硫原子大幅改變了活性：para-DOT（Aleph）作用很強，meta-DOT 卻幾乎沒有效果。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin 合成了硫原子位于不同位置的 TMA-2 衍生物。移动硫原子大幅改变了活性：para-DOT（Aleph）作用很强，meta-DOT 却几乎没有效果。
